events.verdict: Wagner (ORL) legally contests Jovic's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Jovic (MIA) wraps his right arm around Wagner's (ORL) chest, which affects his FOM during the screen.
Jovic (MIA) rests his hands on Wagner's (ORL) body and marginal contact occurs before Wagner sets his intended pick.
Jovic (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Banchero (ORL) on the steal attempt.
Robinson (MIA) lifts his arm as part of a normal basketball move as Bitadze (ORL) reaches in and the ensuing contact with Bitadze's head/face is incidental.
Banchero (ORL) jumps alongside Robinson (MIA) on his contest and any marginal contact is created by Robinson extending his arm toward Banchero during the dunk attempt.
Herro (MIA) legally contests Banchero's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Black (ORL) extends his leg out and makes intentional foot-to-ball contact.
Isaac (ORL) and Adebayo (MIA) mutually engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs during the inbound.
Isaac (ORL) cleanly deflects the pass out of bounds. Possession is correctly retained by the Heat.
Isaac (ORL) extends his arm toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Ware (MIA) as he completes the dunk attempt.
Prior to the timeout by Orlando, the contact between Ware (MIA) and Wagner (ORL) is incidental.
Jovic (MIA) and Ware (MIA) legally contest Wagner's (ORL) shot attempt.
Banchero (ORL) contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Adebayo (MIA) legally contests Wagner's (ORL) last-second shot attempt.
Black (ORL) and Jovic (MIA) come together at the same spot as Black steals the pass and the contact between the two players is incidental.
Carter Jr. (ORL) has his arms in a vertical position and any body contact is marginal as he defends during Adebayo's (MIA) dunk.
Adebayo (MIA) briefly grasps Banchero's (ORL) left arm as they engage and immediately disengage during the screen.
Banchero (ORL) grabs and pulls Jovic's (MIA) jersey away from his body off-ball, which affects Jovic's ability to defend.
da Silva (ORL) jumps into and initiates contact with Adebayo's (MIA) body, which alters his shot attempt in the lane.
Banchero (ORL) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession correctly remains with the Heat.
da Silva (ORL) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Jovic (MIA) as incidental contact occurs during the drive. Subsequently, da Silva legally contests Jovic's shot attempt in the lane.
Jovic (MIA) legally contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Black (ORL) grasps and immediately releases Adebayo's (MIA) jersey and marginal contact occurs as they briefly engage during the rebound.
Robinson (MIA) deflects the pass away from Black (ORL) and the ensuing contact as the players come together at the same spot is incidental.
Miami signals for and is granted a timeout prior to Adebayo's (MIA) shot attempt. Miami retains possession with 1.8 seconds remaining on the gam clock.
Ware's (MIA) shot attempt touches the wiring behind the basket and backboard and is correctly ruled out of bounds. Possession is awarded to the Magic.
Jovic (MIA) legally contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the incidental contact as he defends Herro (MIA).
Black (ORL) legally contests Robinson's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) makes clean contact with the loose ball to deflect it away from Carter Jr. (ORL) during the rebound.
Ware (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it away from Banchero (ORL) during the rebound. Any ensuing follow-through contact after the dislodge is deemed incidental.
da Silva (ORL) establishes himself in a wide screening position but the contact with Adebayo (MIA) is marginal.
Adebayo (MIA) avoids making any contact with Banchero (ORL) as Banchero loses control of his dribble during the drive.
Carter Jr. (ORL) maintains a legal guarding position and incidental contact occurs as he defends Adebayo (MIA) during the drive.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms if there is illegal contact by Carter Jr. (ORL) during Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
During the pick, Carter Jr. (ORL) briefly rests his hands on Jovic's (MIA) body and marginal contact occurs as he releases to roll toward the basket.
Ware (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects the pass away from Carter Jr. (ORL).
Banchero (ORL) and Adebayo (MIA) come together at the same spot and marginal contact occurs after Adebayo secures the loose ball.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) makes contact with the ball before any marginal follow-through contact with Robinson's (MIA) arm during the steal attempt.
Banchero (ORL) legally contests Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Jovic (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Wagner (ORL) during the driving shot attempt and incidental "high-five" contact after the release.
